description: This Python script sets up a voice assistant bot pipeline integrating speech-to-text, language modeling, text-to-speech, and video avatar services. It configures transport parameters, initializes services, constructs an asynchronous pipeline, and defines event handlers for client connections and disconnections.

classes.description: Aggregates the LLM context and user parameters for conversation management.

classes.description: Configuration parameters for the pipeline execution.
